caption: The drawing depicts a single kitchen utensil consisting of two main components: a rectangular wire frame base with raised, curving sides and four short feet, and a central handle that extends vertically from the middle of the base. The handle is elongated, narrow, and rounded at the top, with lines suggesting a wood texture, and it is attached to the wire frame with a twisted metal shaft. The wire frame has a repeating wavy pattern along the top edges on each side and two parallel straight bars running lengthwise inside the base, providing structural support. The entire drawing is rendered in fine black linework on a beige background, giving the image a monochromatic appearance.
title: Toast Rack
